description: Kept the mud outside, named the sixpence till Lady Day, and wanted quiet after nine.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Answered for the loom, and took the bench by the pillar.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Greeted the porch and set fourteen heads on the epistle.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Walked over with the household and took the draughty end of the bench.
name: William Shakespeare
